timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hello, I'm Kevin Rice, Senior Attackman, Circus University, and this is our locker room.
Rice with one!
Oh!
It's over!
Over here is my locker.
We've got space, a little slot for our sticks.
Cubbyhole is down low for shoes.
Everyone has a chair.
You have a nice little lock box here in case you want to, you know, put phone, wallet,
anything in there, keys during practice or when you're working out.
We have plenty of space for blogs and armpits and other equipment.
Space for two helmets up top and up top there above the locker.
Everyone usually keeps their travel bag and anything else that they might need on the road that you don't need during everyday practice.
One of the nice things about these lockers actually is inside their vents, they keep air running.
So when you put your equipment away after practice or after shoot around, it doesn't stay damp.
It'll dry out pretty quickly and it sort of helps keep the smell out of the locker room too.
There's 58 of us so you can get pretty bad in here sometimes.
Over here we have our coaches keep us supplied pretty nicely with some peanut butter and jelly and fluff and bread.
So that way when guys show up a little late for practice because they're coming from class, they can grab some quick to eat.
Over here we have two TVs in the front which guys usually watch for practice.
That board or the wall over here is actually more of a white board than a wall.
Coaches can write on it and that's where the projector goes to.
Guys pull up their chairs, usually have the captains sit up front and we watch film over here.
And actually when we're not watching film you'll find guys in here pretty much all day for practice after practice.
We have an Xbox hooked up to it so there's always an NHL or a FIFA tournament going on if you want to get involved and want.
Over here George, our equipment manager, it leaves us a little note for what equipment and what color we're going to be wearing that week.
Over here we've got a bike that guys used to warm up a little bit before practice.
I know Nikki Giloso is a big fan of this bike.
We've got a sound system that Matt Lane has supplied for the team.
We actually have one in here but we've gotten in trouble a little bit for playing music too loud so this little guy comes with us pretty much everywhere we go and is our source for entertainment.
And as we move this way sort of further into the locker room on the wall over here we have the other teams line up card for the week.
It's nice especially early in the week before we've done a film and got our scouting reports.
Guys come in, check out the position that they might be going against.
I'll come in, check out the defenders, see their hands, see if you recognize any names, the guys you played before.
This is Jamie Dermott, sorry to thunder.
On the wall over here we actually have some of our strength and conditioning winners for different categories.
I want to have you zoom in too close, you don't need the world known who failed the run test.
But over here sometimes it's called RedShirtRow, sometimes we get the higher numbers down here, some of the freshmen.
This board I know coach Rogers likes to use it a lot. He'll pull it out after film if you think guys need a little extra description of what we're doing defensively that week.
He'll draw it out.
And then back here is the shower. We have a pretty big shower, there's two main things with the shower heads around it.
Guys have sort of made an impromptu shower curtain here, trying to keep the steam in.
I know after games, everyone's pretty sore, this would be pretty full and we'll have a lot of guys sort of relax and try to work off the game a little bit.
I think our locker room is pretty special. When I was being recruited and visiting it was definitely one of the nicer ones that I saw it was brand new at that point.
I think we have a ride range of stuff here that guys can do. There's TVs in every rows. We have video games, there's plenty of room for everyone.
I think it just helps guys if they need a place to go during the day or they've got some time to kill before practice.
They're in here and hanging out with their teammates. We're spending time together outside of practice and lift and run.
Which is good because I think you don't always want to be focused on the cross and get them better.
When you can do it in an environment like this where it's safe and there's no way anyone's getting in trouble or doing anything wrong, it can't hurt.

We have a bunch of guys on our team so the more we can get to know each other especially early in the year, freshman and seniors maybe spend more time together in here than they would outside of the locker room.
It's good for team camaraderie and it's something that you need moving forward down the season.
2014 was a magical run for Albany's Lyle Thompson. He won the Tour Tontrofi.
Broke the NCAA record for points in a single season and was a human highlight wheel.
Who's going to come up with it? It's Lyle Thompson.
